profile.title: Synthetic gateway, BAN, and analysis/control station closed loop

validity.physiological_state: abstract gateway-to-station communication without physical wearable or wide-area network
validity.description: Checks trace-preserving measurement uplink, explicit allow-list governance, BAN command return, and local delivery to an actuator endpoint.

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M6.4 active gateway software contract
sources.role: network-neutral gateway measurement and command boundary

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M6.5 BAN and external-station software contract
sources.role: adapter, governance, traceability, and synthetic transport semantics

limitations: All latency, energy, capacity, and outcome values are synthetic software-verification values.
The scheduled BAN adapter is not a calibrated Bluetooth, IEEE 802.15.6, cellular, Internet, or anatomical propagation model.
Governance is a deterministic transport allow-list and causal-trace check, not identity authentication, cryptographic authorization, or clinical safety approval.
A delivered control message does not execute payload release or change a physiological model.
